name: IPQualityScore
tagline: Fraud, proxy/VPN, and email validation scoring APIs.
description: IPQualityScore (IPQS) provides real-time fraud prevention APIs for IP reputation, proxy/VPN/tor detection, email validation, phone verification, device fingerprinting, and transaction risk scoring. Developers use scored risk signals to block abuse, reduce chargebacks, and validate user identity at signup or checkout.

auth.details: API key path segment after /api/json/{service}/YOUR_API_KEY/; self-serve dashboard signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan with limited monthly lookups (tier varies; confirm on pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans by monthly volume; see ipqualityscore.com/pricing

use_cases: score an IP for proxy, VPN, or tor risk
validate email deliverability and fraud risk
check phone number legitimacy before signup
enrich login or checkout with IP reputation
detect disposable email or high-risk devices
